items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: My roommate was their booker, used to write the letters for them to get the jobs, which he did a little bit for us

ctx.x: So but that's all we did, but we came along and I think we had a pretty good band. Now, we got chances to listen to maybe the Mason Dixon orchestra which was a traveling band, The Waring Banjo Orchestra. Fred Waring.

Well Tom had it then. Fred was still at school while I was there. He was at Penn State which was 60 miles away. But he used to come down. My roommate was their booker, used to write the letters for them to get the jobs, which he did a little bit for us, having the advantage there.
